skill.description: Generate or edit AI music through the RunComfy CLI. The skill selects ElevenLabs Music or ACE Step routes for quality, budget, language, and editing needs.
skill.summary: Route music requests to RunComfy models with documented prompts and CLI invocations.
skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: All static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, documentation links, and model-selection language. The skill documents intentional RunComfy CLI use and credential handling, but no malicious behavior, prompt injection, hidden execution, or data-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Third-party CLI installation and remote music generation are required.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for user confirmation before installing or authenticating the CLI, and document the expected RunComfy endpoints and charges.

remediation.issue: Audio editing accepts user-provided remote audio URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Continue accepting only URLs explicitly supplied by the user and clearly state that source audio is uploaded to the selected provider.

remediation.issue: Authentication tokens are stored by the external CLI.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the 0600 storage guidance and advise users to use environment-based tokens in ephemeral CI environments.

content.value_statement: Creating music requires choosing a model, writing an effective prompt, and managing cost. This skill routes requests to suitable RunComfy music models and provides documented invocation patterns.
actual_capabilities: Selects a music route based on quality, budget, language, and whether audio needs editing.
Provides prompt structures for ElevenLabs Music and ACE Step generation.
Generates instrumental or vocal music requests through documented RunComfy CLI commands.
Supports time-bounded audio inpainting for a section of an existing track.
Supports audio outpainting to add an introduction or outro to an existing track.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, an account, and valid authentication.
Model availability, pricing, output quality, and processing time are controlled by external providers.
It does not verify rights to lyrics, source audio, or generated music.
Audio edits require a user-provided accessible audio URL and follow model duration limits.

use_cases.title: Create a campaign jingle
use_cases.description: Produce a short polished vocal or instrumental cue for a marketing campaign.

use_cases.title: Build a game music library
use_cases.description: Create affordable background tracks and loops with varied style tags.

use_cases.title: Repair a song section
use_cases.description: Replace a chorus or extend a short draft while preserving the intended style.

prompt_templates.title: Create an instrumental
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30-second upbeat instrumental for a product demo. Use a bright electronic style with no vocals.

prompt_templates.title: Write a vocal jingle
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 15-second premium pop jingle. Include a concise original chorus about reliable delivery and use a confident female vocal.

prompt_templates.title: Generate multilingual drafts
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three 60-second multilingual pop-song drafts with the same indie-pop tags. Use separate original lyrics for English, Spanish, and Japanese.

prompt_templates.title: Extend an existing hook
prompt_templates.prompt: Extend my user-provided 30-second hook with a 20-second introduction and 60-second outro. Keep the indie-pop style and make the transitions natural.

output_examples.input: Create affordable background music for a puzzle game.
output: Recommended route: ACE Step base for cost-sensitive instrumental drafts.
Suggested tags: playful electronic, marimba, light percussion, seamless loop, 100 BPM.
The response includes a documented RunComfy invocation pattern.

output_examples.input: My second chorus does not fit the song.
output: The response requests the time range, source audio URL, and matching style tags.
It then provides a time-bounded edit pattern.

best_practices: State the intended duration, genre, mood, instruments, vocal preference, and budget before generating.
Use short low-cost drafts to refine the style before commissioning a longer premium render.
Provide only audio URLs and lyrics that you have permission to use.
anti_patterns: Do not include secrets or authentication tokens in prompts, lyrics, or command input.
Do not assume generated music is cleared for every commercial or copyright use.
Do not use an untrusted audio URL for editing without confirming its source and rights.

faq.question: Which model should I use for low-cost drafts?
faq.answer: Use ACE Step base for cost-sensitive background music, loops, and iteration.

faq.question: Which model is suitable for polished vocal music?
faq.answer: Use ElevenLabs Music when premium vocal quality and commercial presentation are the priority.

faq.question: Can the skill create instrumental music?
faq.answer: Yes. Specify that you want no vocals or use the instrumental option supported by the selected model.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing track?
faq.answer: Yes. ACE Step supports time-bounded inpainting and before-or-after outpainting with a source audio URL.

faq.question: Does this skill store my token?
faq.answer: The external RunComfy CLI stores its token with restricted permissions after login. Use an environment variable for CI when appropriate.

faq.question: Are lyrics and source audio checked for rights?
faq.answer: No. You are responsible for confirming that you have the rights to submit lyrics and source audio.
